crossRefs.note: as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

translations.web: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
translations.bsb: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
translations.kjv: For if I make ➔ you sorry, who is he then that maketh ➔ me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
translations.asv: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?
